question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**resources**" refers to available assets that can be used to benefit a person, organization, or environment.
 
• The Deep Ocean Mission is aimed at exploring and harnessing underwater resources sustainably.
 
• The other options: "sectors," "assets," and "subjects" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** "*Deep Ocean Mission would not result in any over-exploitation of marine resources__ by corporate houses and will not affect the life and livelihoods of .................."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sectors:** parts or divisions of a larger system or economy.
 
• **Assets:** resources or items of value owned.
 
• **Subjects:** individuals or areas under discussion or analysis.
